question:
Select the option that is related to Figure C in the same way as Figure B is related to Figure A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fac5ab76c95c32841c68ee8ead7a82f36489566e595c0941a27d0cfb9fb99d11.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: Element at the top left corner + 1 the side of element in the next image.

Step II: Element at the bottom left corner moved to middle with double of it in the next image.

Step III: Element at the bottom right corner has the mirror image covered with box in the next image.
